testCase:
S-04: Colour, size and quantity before "Add to cart"
Goal: Add 2 Fernhill Fleece Zip Hoodies for Men in Midnight, size M, to my cart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/s-04/
STEP 2: Open "Fernhill Fleece Zip Hoodie for Men"
STEP 3: Choose the colour "Midnight"
STEP 4: Choose the size "M"
STEP 5: Set the quantity to 2
STEP 6: Click "Add to cart"
STEP 7: Verify "Added to cart: 2 × Fernhill Fleece Zip Hoodie for Men (Midnight, M)" is visible

plan.title: Add two Midnight hoodies in size M
